goal: A per-item pipeline state machine that runs the whole Dev and Ops flow as code, woken by events.
why: The orchestration must not depend on a hub model reading rules.
acceptance: states PLANNED, DISPATCHED, ACTING, REPORTED, VERDICT, SEND_BACK, INTEGRATED, DEPLOYED, OBSERVED with code-only transitions
woken by mailbox/push events, no polling; every wait has a deadline
role edges and spec-only rule of baseline ops/flow/flow.py are enforced inside it
model sessions are opened only as escalation
constraints: spec only: Dev/Ops decide method and plan
